Hint: You may wish to make use of the fact that 1296=362.

a
 (g−6h)4
b
 (g+36h)(g+6h)(g−6h)
c
 (g2+36h2)(g−6h)2
d
 (g2+6h2)(g+3h)(g−3h)
e
 (g2+36h2)(g+6h)(g−6h)
